name: freshness-read-projection-helper
body: `freshness_read` is a private projection helper in `src/git/state.rs` (typed downcast to `FreshnessReadFailure` plus a panic-free fallback) because `freshness_read_retry` returns `anyhow::Result`, a signature the existing unit tests pin; collapse the helper into its callers if the retry ever returns the typed failure directly.
